title: My New Puppy
description: Three short recordings about a boy and his new puppy.
instructions: Read the questions first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · At school
parts.intro: You will hear Tom and Mai talking about a puppy.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Hello, Mai! I have a new puppy.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Wow! What colour is it?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: It is brown, not black. It has a white nose.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: What is its name?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Its name is Biscuit.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Can I see it?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Yes! Come to my house.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: He is so small and soft. I like puppies very much.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Me too. He is my best friend now.

parts.title: Part 2 · The puppy
parts.intro: You will hear Tom talking about his puppy.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: My puppy likes chicken, but he does not like carrots.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: He sleeps in a small blue bed. He does not sleep on my bed.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I love to play with a red ball.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Every day after school, I run with him in the garden.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: He is a good, happy dog.

parts.title: Part 3 · At home
parts.intro: You will hear Mai and Tom's dad at his house.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Hello! Is that your puppy?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Yes. He is very happy today.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Can I give him some water?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Yes, please. The bowl is in the kitchen.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: He is so cute. I like him!

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Come and sit with us. The puppy likes visitors.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Thank you. I am very happy to be here.

questions.explanation: Tom says the puppy is brown, not black.

questions.text: What is white on the puppy?
questions.explanation: Tom says it has a white nose.
Tom says its name is Biscuit.

questions.text: Does Mai want to see the puppy?
questions.explanation: Mai asks, "Can I see it?" so she wants to see it.

questions.text: What does the puppy like to eat?
questions.explanation: The puppy likes chicken, not carrots.
He sleeps in a small blue bed, not on Tom's bed.

evidence.quote: I love to play with a red ball.

questions.explanation: Mai asks to give him some water.
